proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q r x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ hab hne hl₁ hl₂ hc₁ hc₂
  have hN : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    by_cases ha₀ : a = 0
    · have hb₀ : b ≠ 0 := fun hb₀ => hab ⟨ha₀, hb₀⟩
      positivity
    · positivity
  have he : a * (x₁ - x₂) + b * (y₁ - y₂) = 0 := by linarith
  have hd : (x₁ - x₂) * (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) + (y₁ - y₂) * (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) = 0 := by linear_combination hc₁ - hc₂
  have hm : a * (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) + b * (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) = -2 * (a * p + b * q + c) := by linear_combination hl₁ + hl₂
  have hC₁ : (x₁ - x₂) * (a * (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) - b * (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p)) = 0 := by
    linear_combination (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) * he - b * hd
  have hC₂ : (y₁ - y₂) * (a * (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) - b * (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p)) = 0 := by
    linear_combination a * hd - (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) * he
  have hC : a * (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) - b * (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) = 0 := by
    by_contra hC
    exact hne ⟨by linarith [(mul_eq_zero.mp hC₁).resolve_right hC], by linarith [(mul_eq_zero.mp hC₂).resolve_right hC]⟩
  have hsum : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * ((x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) ^ 2 + (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) ^ 2) = 4 * (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 := by
    have : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * ((x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) ^ 2 + (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) ^ 2) = (a * (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) + b * (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q)) ^ 2 + (a * (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) - b * (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p)) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [this, hm, hC]; ring
  have hpar : (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 + (y₁ - y₂) ^ 2 + ((x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) ^ 2 + (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) ^ 2) = 4 * r ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination 2 * hc₁ + 2 * hc₂
  have hmval : (x₁ + x₂ - 2 * p) ^ 2 + (y₁ + y₂ - 2 * q) ^ 2 = 4 * (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hN]; linear_combination hsum
  have : 4 * (r ^ 2 - (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) = 4 * r ^ 2 - 4 * (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by ring
  rw [this, ← hmval]
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q r x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ : ℝ), ¬(a = 0 ∧ b = 0) → ¬(x₁ = x₂ ∧ y₁ = y₂) → a * x₁ + b * y₁ + c = 0 → a * x₂ + b * y₂ + c = 0 → (x₁ - p) ^ 2 + (y₁ - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 → (x₂ - p) ^ 2 + (y₂ - q) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 → (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2 + (y₁ - y₂) ^ 2 = 4 * (r ^ 2 - (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2))
